title: packages: a tenant exports its whole ontology — every installed package, its `.custom` pair and environment customizations — as installable packages for the open runtime (`os package export` + the read it calls)
body:
director#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jV5sBSzCYNEDgpYLJw

Blocked-by: #29617
Unlock-action: re-check #29617 when it is closed (server slice resumes; claim 6589102677 released)

Filing gate: **② a maintainer decision.** The maintainer, on docs.objectos.ai #334 question 1 (batch #452 item 5), verbatim: 「Cloud/Enterprise 租户怎么导出本体?同意,同时立开发卡。」 — ruling 6568804196 (docs.objectos.ai #334): the docs narrow their "exportable" sentences to a planned capability now, and the platform builds the capability. This card is that capability. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's; the read and the command are a new served surface, so the spec slice comes first.
Business reason: ObjectOS's positioning (E1 in `apps/docs/lib/positioning.ts` of docs.objectos.ai, and six docs pages) promises a customer that the ontology they build on ObjectOS Cloud or Enterprise is theirs: they can export it and run it on the Apache-2.0 runtime. Today no door does that. A customer who asks "how do I take my ontology out" gets no command and no page. Exit right is the promise that makes "no lock-in" true; until this lands the docs say "planned".
Reader who acts: `domain:spec` for the shape (`packages/spec/src/api/export.zod.ts` / `package-lifecycle.zod.ts`, `Metadata-protocol: added`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`), then `domain:server` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, `packages/cli`). The docs page "export your ontology" follows on docs.objectos.ai #334 once this lands.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `ontology export` → 10 hits, none about an export door (#27261 federation, #26140/#22951/#22172/#21838 positioning prose, the rest unrelated); `export in:title is:open` → 0; `"deployment export" OR "tenant export" OR "export all packages"` → 0 relevant (#24143 and #8484 are the CSV data export). Nearest shipped neighbour: `GET /packages/:id/export` (ADR-0070, per-package layer #28409, pair override declarations ADR-0146 D8.3), which is one package at a time.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**(本卡要做的):给平台加一个「导出整个租户本体」的门:一次调用导出这个部署里所有已安装的包(基础包、它们的 `.custom` 配对包、环境级定制),得到一组可以在开源运行时上直接安装的包;配一个 `os package export` 命令调用它。
- **为什么**:官网和文档承诺「本体是你的,可以导出到开源运行时跑」,今天没有任何入口;docs #334 按您的裁定先把文案收窄成「规划中」,这张卡把它做成真的。
- **先看**:今天只有按包导出 `GET /packages/:id/export`(27 种元数据类型,一次一个包);CLI 只有 `package install` / `package publish`。
- **需要你做的**:无;分诊定级定车道后由 spec 席先定形状。

## Measured (`origin/main` `9a9823d9`, read-only)

- `GET /packages/:id/export` exists (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:402`): the whole-package export of one package, 27 metadata types, reading that package's own layer (#28409) and carrying a pair's override declarations (ADR-0146 D8.3). It is gated by the builder roles like `GET /packages/:id`.
- There is no read that exports every package a deployment holds, and nothing that names the set of installed packages as one exportable bundle with their dependency order.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/package/` holds `install.ts` and `publish.ts` only; `os package export` does not exist (docs.objectos.ai #332 removed a mention of it).
- Secrets: #28596 withholds connector credential positions on read; an export must inherit that (a bundle never carries a credential, a `credentialRef` is kept as the reference it is).

## Wanted

1. **The shape (spec first).** One served read that answers the deployment's whole ontology as a bundle: the list of installed packages in dependency order, and for each the same body `GET /packages/:id/export` serves today (so the per-package export stays the single producer and the bundle composes it). The `.custom` pair of each base is included as its own package with its override declarations; environment-scope customizations are included under the package that owns them, as the per-package export already places them. Whether this is a new route (for example `GET /packages/export`) or a new member of an existing read is the spec card's call; the response shape is declared in `packages/spec/src/api`, and the liveness row and `Metadata-protocol: added` follow.
2. **The command.** `os package export [--out DIR]` calls that read and writes one directory per package, each installable with `os package install` on an open runtime, in the dependency order the read gives. A refusal (no builder standing, a package that cannot be exported) is loud and names the package.
3. **Nothing secret leaves.** The bundle carries no credential value: the #28596 withholding applies on this read as on every other, and `credentialRef` names survive as references. A test proves a connector with `auth.credentialRef` exports with the reference and without the secret.
4. **Round trip.** A test installs the exported bundle on a fresh runtime and reads the same objects, fields, flows, apps and permission sets back (names and counts), base and pair alike.

## Done criteria

- `os package export` on a deployment with a base, its `.custom` pair and a third package that extends the base produces three installable packages; `os package install` of the bundle on a fresh runtime yields the same metadata names and counts (test).
- A connector with `auth.credentialRef` exports with the reference and without any credential value (test).
- The served read's response is declared in `packages/spec/src/api` and validated by the route (`Metadata-protocol: added`, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record on the PR).
- docs.objectos.ai #334 gets its "export your ontology" page as a follow-up once this lands (the docs lane files it; not this card's scope).

Dedupe words: ontology export, tenant export, whole-deployment export, os package export, export bundle, exit right.

Ruling-ref: docs.objectos.ai #334 comment 6568804196 (batch #452 item 5, Q1 → B + development card).
Related: docs.objectos.ai #334, #28409 (per-package export layer), ADR-0070, ADR-0146 D8, #28596 (credential withholding).
